## Mastercard to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference


November 24, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_news/Mastercard-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conference-4446d2826-2026.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) today announced that on Tuesday, December 1, Devin Corr, Executive Vice President of Investor Relations, will present at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference in Scottsdale, AZ. The discussion will begin at 4:15 p.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 30 minutes.


There will be a live audio webcast of the discussions and replay will be archived for 30 days at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54645916&newsitemid=20261124874026&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=1&md5=6f4beb129ba7a9639d5923f96928bfdc) .


**About Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA),**[www.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mastercard.com&esheet=54645916&newsitemid=20261124874026&lan=en-US&anchor=www.mastercard.com&index=2&md5=1598e62800b299ed48161e2fcdb1fa3f)


Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re building a resilient economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
